edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender() (msg.sender), making ownership caller-dependent.
Operator constructor assigns _operator from _msgSender() (msg.sender).
onlyOperator compares _operator to msg.sender for authorization.
onlyOwner compares _owner to _msgSender() for authorization.
setPeriod is gated by the onlyOperator modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOperator is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
update() is gated by checkEpoch, which compares block.timestamp (now) to nextEpochPoint(), a timestamp dependency.
Elapsed-time math in update() derives from blockTimestamp, which is derived from block.timestamp.
nextEpochPoint returns startTime plus epoch*period.
nextEpochPoint multiplies the current epoch counter by period.
nextEpochPoint multiplies the current epoch counter by period.
update() performs the external Uniswap oracle call before writing state.
The stored pair address is passed to UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices.
price0Cumulative is returned by the external oracle call.
price1Cumulative is returned by the external oracle call.
blockTimestamp is returned by the external oracle call.
External call to the Uniswap pair can re-enter update() before state variables are updated.
blockTimestamp feeds the unchecked subtraction producing timeElapsed.
blockTimestampLast is subtracted from blockTimestamp without a wrap-around guard.
timeElapsed is the result of the unchecked uint32 subtraction.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the price delta division in update().
price0Cumulative is the minuend of the unchecked cumulative-price subtraction.
price0CumulativeLast is the subtrahend of the unchecked cumulative-price subtraction.
The divided value is cast to uint224 and stored into price0Average.
The divided value is cast to uint224 and stored into price1Average.
update() stores the fresh price0Cumulative into price0CumulativeLast.
update() stores the fresh price1Cumulative into price1CumulativeLast.
update() stores the fresh blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast.
consult branches on the token argument to choose price0Average or price1Average.
amountIn is the multiplier applied to the stored average price.
price0Average is read and multiplied by amountIn inside consult.
price1Average is read and multiplied by amountIn inside consult.
amountOut is computed from amountIn and the average price.
amountOut is returned by consult.
